title: New Red Sox reliever Erik Miller says he learned about trade from TV
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Erik Miller learned about his trade to the Red Sox from a TV broadcast.
The Red Sox acquired Erik Miller from the Giants in exchange for Marcelo Mayer.
Miller struck out the only batter he faced in his debut at Fenway Park.

title: ‘Sheer grit and determination’: Mass. 18-year-old with leg injury meets rescuers halfway on Mount Washington
author: John Waller
bullets: Andrew Nelson, 18, from Massachusetts, injured his leg while hiking on Mount Washington, unable to bear weight.
Despite his injury, Nelson hiked 0.3 miles back toward the summit as rescuers approached.
Rescuers used a vacuum splint and litter to transport Nelson, who declined hospital treatment.

title: Body washes up at Orient Heights Beach in East Boston
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: A female body was found at Orient Heights Beach in East Boston at 1 p.m. Tuesday.
The body was discovered on the shore near Bayswater Street, according to Suffolk County DA's office.
Authorities are conducting an ongoing investigation into the circumstances of the death.

title: Charts: See how much Markey and Moulton have raised so far
author: Annie Jonas
bullets: Seth Moulton has out-raised Ed Markey by nearly $1 million for the Massachusetts Democratic U.S. Senate primaries.
Moulton raised $5.6 million from 2025 through June 2026; Markey collected approximately $4.8 million in the same period.
As of June 30, Moulton reported $2.6 million in cash reserves, while Markey reported $2.2 million.

title: Weston police investigating after masked person spotted outside home overnight
author: John Waller
bullets: Weston police investigate masked individual seen outside a Highland Street home between 2:30-3:30 a.m. Sunday.
The suspect, wearing a bicycle helmet, did not enter the home but was on private property overnight.
Authorities request public assistance with surveillance footage that may aid their investigation of the incident.

title: Livestream: Lindsay Clancy murder trial resumes with a half-day of testimony
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Lindsay Clancy's murder trial continues in Plymouth with a half-day session, with testimony focusing on her hospitalization.
A physician assistant testified about treating cuts on Clancy's wrists following her hospitalization for a suicide attempt.
Clancy is charged with murdering her three children and claims an insanity defense citing postpartum mental illness influences.

title: This budget airline at Logan Airport is adding first class seats in 2027
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Allegiant will introduce first-class seating on select aircraft at Logan Airport in 2027.
The Allegiant First seats will offer enhanced features and amenities, including priority boarding and baggage allowance.
Allegiant merged with Sun Country Airlines but will continue operating separately for 18 to 24 months.

title: Caleb Durbin’s resurgence has been a symbol of Red Sox’ improbable run
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Caleb Durbin's resurgence is helping power the Red Sox, highlighted by his first career grand slam against the White Sox.
Boston's current six-game win streak includes a 24-3 run, leading the AL in home runs and MLB in team ERA.
Key trade additions like Adley Rutschman and Erik Miller bolster an already potent Red Sox lineup for a postseason push.

title: Recent homes sales in Greater Boston (Aug. 5)
author: The Boston Globe
bullets: Abington's highest recent home sale was a Colonial at 22 Nardone Circle for $1,185,000.
In Andover, a modern Colonial at 2 Barron Court sold for $2,400,000.
Arlington saw a notable sale of a Colonial at 85 Oakland Ave for $2,755,000.

title: Jarren Duran: ‘I thought I was going to be released’ by Red Sox
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Jarren Duran remains with the Boston Red Sox after trade rumors, despite perceived underperformance this season.
Duran, batting .200, feared release due to his struggles and outbursts, including criticism during a recent game.
Despite difficulties, Duran has potential for a 20-20 season with 15 home runs and 16 stolen bases.
